lines.beaver_en: Minji, what sports do you like?
Oh, badminton? Do you play often?
lines.en: Yes, I go to the court every weekend.

lines.beaver_en: Have you ever entered a tournament?
lines.en: I entered last year, but I lost in the end.

lines.beaver_en: That must have been disappointing. Do you watch the Olympics too?
lines.learner: 네, 올림픽 때는 스케이트를 꼭 봐요.
lines.en: Yes, I always watch skating during the Olympics.
lines.roman: ne, ollimpik ttaeneun seukeiteureul kkok bwayo.

lines.beaver: 저도 스케이트 좋아해요. 직접 타 봤어요?
lines.beaver_en: I like skating too. Have you tried it yourself?
lines.beaver_roman: jeodo seukeiteu joahaeyo. jikjeop ta bwasseoyo?
lines.learner: 한 번 타 봤는데 너무 어려웠어요.
lines.en: I tried it once, but it was really hard.
lines.roman: han beon ta bwanneunde neomu eoryeowosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, everyone's like that at first. What about bowling?
lines.en: I won first place at the company bowling contest.
I practiced every week. It's really fun.

lines.beaver_en: Shall we talk more about badminton?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 배드민턴 잘 치는 법이 궁금해요.
lines.en: Sure. I'm curious how to play badminton well.
lines.roman: joayo. baedeuminteon jal chineun beobi gunggeumhaeyo.

lines.beaver: 제가 알려 줄게요. 주말에 같이 칠까요?
lines.beaver_en: I'll teach you. Shall we play together this weekend?
lines.beaver_roman: jega allyeo julgeyo. jumare gachi chilkkayo?
lines.en: Great! This time I won't lose.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, I'm looking forward to it. How about Saturday morning?
lines.en: Okay, see you at the court on Saturday!
